We need number of CH3 groups in the compound. But we have no description of compound. Possibly we need to infer from NMR? We have no SMILES. We could request proton NMR spectra? But we don't know the compound. Maybe the system expects we ask for proton NMR and deduce number of methyls from peaks? But we need the compound identity? The task likely expects we have a sample at hand (the environment). We can call proton_nmr_spectra to get 1H NMR. Then count methyl signals (singlet, doublet, triplet around 0.9-1.5 ppm). But ambiguous.

Better: Use carbon_nmr_spectra to see number of methyl carbons (~10-30 ppm). Count distinct signals.

We can call carbon_nmr_spectra.
